text:
alex: Heads up — p99 for mariner-v3 (long-context workloads) jumped from ~450ms to ~2.8s starting around 03:12 UTC. Alerts firing for multiple customers (example ticket #1357). @maria can you triage? https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/abc123 :eyes:

monitoring-bot: [ALERT] model.mariner-v3.p99_latency_long_ctx > 2.5s (5m window). Affected hosts: infer-04, infer-09. trace_id=abc123

maria: On it. Can you drop any recent deploy logs? cc @ingrid @sachin

ingrid: No mariner-v3 canary ->prod deploys at that time. We did push a tokenizer heuristic change to staging yesterday that introduces a fallback path for unusual unicode clusters (emoji-heavy inputs). Might be hitting the slow path on long inputs.

sachin: I'm seeing auth service retry amplification around 03:10-03:18 — outbound auth client got 500s and retried which cascaded into extra latency for inference calls. The retry backoff/jitter caused 300-600ms added per request when the token refresh path tripped.

maria: Customer repro (short): they POST to /v1/generate with ~9k prompt (mostly text + emoji), p99 spike reproducible. Repro snippet:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mariner-v3","input":"<9k chars>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

alex: Can we route traffic away from mariner-v3 for long-context requests until we root cause? mariner-v2-quant is compatible and cheap.

ingrid: I can add a routing override + disable the tokenizer fallback in prod (temporary). Also will enable prefix KV cache warming for longctx to reduce cold-kv misses.

ops-bot: routing-service: override applied — route=mariner-v3 -> mariner-v2-quant for requests with param.long_context=true for orgs in high-usage cohort (40% traffic).

sachin: I patched the auth client timeout and reduced retry count for the inference path (3 -> 1), added jitter cap. That should eliminate most retry amplification.

maria: Notified customer about a mitigation plan and temporary routing.

ingrid: Early numbers: affected host p99 dropped from ~2.8s -> ~480ms after routing + auth patch + cache warming. We're still seeing rare tails when tokenizer enters fallback on long emoji/zero-width sequences. I'll backport a fast-path patch for the tokenizer that avoids full normalization on those sequences and schedule a shaded rollout.

alex: Good work. Please add a short reproducible unit test to eng-runtime for the emoji-heavy longctx case and a smoke in staging.

maria: Will keep ticket open until stable and will follow up with customer. :white_check_mark:
